name: local-ai-b70-observatory
description: Local AI B70 Observatory – observability dashboard and OpenAI-compatible gateway for the local Qwen/vLLM server

scripts.build: npm run build -w @observatory/contracts && npm run build -w @observatory/runner && npm run build -w @observatory/server && npm run build -w @observatory/web && tsx ops/build-native-helper.ts && tsx ops/build-release-helper.ts && tsx ops/build-release-artifact.ts
scripts.test: npm run build -w @observatory/contracts && npm run build -w @observatory/runner && npm run test -w @observatory/contracts && npm run test -w @observatory/runner && npm run test -w @observatory/server && npm run test -w @observatory/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @observatory/contracts && npm run build -w @observatory/runner && npm run typecheck -w @observatory/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @observatory/runner && npm run typecheck -w @observatory/server && npm run typecheck -w @observatory/web && tsc -p tsconfig.ops.json --noEmit
